DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ボールの貸出をお希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to borrow a ball?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 親子で少し遊びたいです。帰る時刻が決まっているので、十五分だけ使えるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 帰宅時刻固定で親子十五分ボール借用可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My child and I would like to play for a little while. Our departure time is fixed, so I would like to ask whether we can use one for just fifteen minutes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether parent and child can borrow a ball for fifteen minutes because their time to go home is fixed. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 短い時間でもお使いいただけます。返却はこちらの受付です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: You may use it for a short time too. Please return it to this reception desk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 帰る前にここへ戻ります。空気が少し柔らかい物がよいのですが、選べますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 返却位置を確認し柔らかいボール選択を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: We will come back here before leaving. I would prefer one with slightly softer air pressure. Can I choose?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the return location and ask to choose a softer ball. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの二つのうち、軽い物を選べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Of these two, you can choose the lighter one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この軽い方にします。子どもへ、終わりの時刻になったら受付へ返すと先に話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 軽い一つを選び子へ終了時刻返却を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will take this lighter one. I will tell my child beforehand that we will return it to reception when our time is up.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose one light ball and tell your child it will be returned at the finishing time. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 使える範囲はこちらです。周囲を見て遊んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: This is the area where you can use it. Please watch your surroundings while playing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 範囲を確認しました。十五分遊んで戻りましたので、このボールを返します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 使用範囲を確認し十五分後に戻って返却する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I checked the area. We played for fifteen minutes and have come back, so I am returning this ball.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the permitted area and return after fifteen minutes to give the ball back. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受け取りました。傷など、気になることはありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: I have received it. Was there anything concerning, such as damage?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 特にありません。借りた一つをこちらへ渡せたので、子どもと帰ります。短い時間でも遊べてよかったです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 問題なしと一個返却を報告し親子で帰宅する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Nothing in particular. I have handed back the one we borrowed here, so I will go home with my child. I am glad we could play even for a short time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report no problems and the return of one ball, then go home with your child. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご返却ありがとうございました。それでは、またお越しください。さようなら。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for returning it. Please come again. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ホームへ進む前に、何かご案内しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: May I help you with anything before you go to the platform?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもが大きな音を怖がっています。列車が来るまでホームではなく、屋内で一緒に待てる所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 音を怖がる子と屋内待機場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: My child is afraid of loud noises. Is there somewhere indoors where we can wait together until the train comes, rather than on the platform?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for an indoor waiting place with a child afraid of noise. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの待合をご案内できます。ただ、音が全く聞こえない場所ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: I can show you this waiting room. However, it is not a place where no sound can be heard at all.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 完全に静かでなくても構いません。今、子どもは私の手を握っています。列車を見る練習より、まず落ち着いて待ちたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 無音保証不要と子の落着きを優先する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: It does not have to be completely quiet. My child is holding my hand now. Rather than practicing looking at trains, we first want to wait calmly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that silence need not be guaranteed and prioritize your child's calm. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 待合から発車案内も見られます。どの列車を予定していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can also see departure information from the waiting room. Which train are you planning to take?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 次の普通列車です。乗る時間になったら私が一緒に移動します。子どもだけをホームへ先に行かせません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 予定普通列車と親子同時移動を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: The next local train. When it is time to board, I will go together with my child. I will not send my child to the platform ahead alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State the planned local train and that parent and child will move together. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 発車前に余裕を持ってお越しください。扉が閉まる直前まで待つ方法ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please come with time to spare before departure. This does not mean waiting until just before the doors close.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 早めに動きます。急いで抱えて走るより、発車案内を私が見て、歩けるうちに声を掛けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 直前まで待たず案内を見て歩いて向かう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: We will move early. Rather than rushing and running while carrying my child, I will watch the departure information and let my child know while we still have time to walk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not wait until the last moment; watch the information and walk to the platform. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この入口からホームへの道を、今確認しておきますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Would you like to check the route from this entrance to the platform now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 道も確認できました。子どもに待合で少し休み、発車案内を見てから一緒に移ると伝えます。入口からなら歩く距離も分かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 待合入口経路を確認し発車案内後の親子移動を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have checked the route too. I will tell my child that we will rest a little in the waiting room, then check the departure information and go together. I now also know how far we will walk from the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the route from the waiting-room entrance and explain going together after checking departure information. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、ご家族で無理なくご準備ください。お気をつけてご乗車ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please prepare at a comfortable pace as a family. Take care when boarding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 地域の清掃活動をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you interested in the community cleanup?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 親子で参加したいです。子どもに道路のごみを拾わせるのではなく、できる役があるか聞いてから申し込みたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 親子清掃で子が可能な役を申込前に尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to participate with my child. Rather than having my child pick up litter on the road, I would like to ask if there is a suitable role before applying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about a role your child can do in the parent-and-child cleanup before applying. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 作業の場所と参加の条件を、主催担当に確認します。お子様はおいくつでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check the work location and participation conditions with the organizer. How old is your child?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 八歳です。最後まで大人と同じ作業をする約束はできません。私は一緒にいて、途中の休憩も相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 八歳と同作業終日不可と親同行を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Eight. I cannot promise my child can do the same work as adults until the end. I will stay together with my child and would also like to discuss breaks along the way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your child is eight, cannot do the same work all day, and will be accompanied by a parent. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この活動では、受付で道具を渡す補助も候補になります。具体的な役は担当とお決めください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Helping hand out tools at reception is also a possibility in this activity. Please decide the specific role with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 子どもは人に道具を渡すのが好きなので、その候補を本人へ話します。私だけが役を決めて申込む前に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 道具手渡し案を本人へ聞いてから選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: My child likes handing tools to people, so I will discuss that possibility with them. I will ask my child before deciding on a role and applying by myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask your child about the tool-handing option before choosing it. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 参加する時間の希望も、お知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also tell us what hours you would like to participate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 午前の最初の一時間です。終日来る人の欄ではなく、短い時間の参加として伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 午前最初一時間の参加希望を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: The first hour in the morning. Please describe it as short participation, rather than putting us in the category for people attending all day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State that you want to participate for the first morning hour. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当がその時間で可能か確認します。お返事の前に当日来場が決まった扱いにはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will check whether that time is possible. Before their reply, we will not treat your attendance on the day as decided.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。親子、八歳、受付補助の希望、一時間とまとめます。条件が分かってから子どもと参加を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 年齢役時間をまとめ条件後に参加決定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will summarize: parent and child, eight years old, interested in reception assistance, one hour. Once we know the conditions, my child and I will decide whether to participate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Summarize age, role, and time, and decide on participation after learning the conditions. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、主催担当へおつなぎします。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will connect you to the organizer. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今、耳の違和感は続いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is the discomfort in your ear continuing now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今はあまり気になりません。でも、昨日は仕事の途中で何度か耳が詰まった感じがしたので、受診の相談を続けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 現在弱くても昨日反復耳違和感の相談継続を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: It does not bother me much now. But yesterday, while working, I felt my ear was blocked several times, so I would like to continue discussing a medical consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to continue discussing repeated ear discomfort yesterday even though it is mild now. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 弱くなった現在と、昨日の経過を分けて伺います。どちらの耳でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will ask separately about the milder symptoms now and what happened yesterday. Which ear is it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 左です。何時からかは記録していませんが、昼の休憩前には気付きました。右耳には、今の違和感はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 左耳と昨日昼前認知と時刻未記録を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: The left. I did not record what time it began, but I had noticed it before the lunch break. I do not have this discomfort in my right ear now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State that it is the left ear, you noticed it before noon yesterday, and did not record the exact time. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ほかに、聞こえ方で気付いたことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Have you noticed anything else about your hearing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同僚が呼んだ声を二回聞き返しました。ただ、機械の音もある所なので、耳だけが理由だとは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二度聞返しと騒音環境で原因未断定を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I asked my colleague to repeat what they called out twice. However, the place also has machine noise, so I do not know whether my ear alone was the reason.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain asking twice for repetition and that the cause is uncertain in a noisy environment. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その状況も診療担当へ伝えます。以前にも同じことはありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will pass those circumstances on to the clinical staff too. Has the same thing happened before?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 以前のことは思い当たりません。今回は昨日、昼の休憩前に気付いたことをお伝えしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 以前の類似経験は思い当たらず今回の認知時期を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I cannot recall any previous occasion. This time, I would like to tell you that I noticed it yesterday before the lunch break.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you cannot recall a similar prior experience and state when you noticed this episode. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 現在弱いことも含めて、問診票へお書きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please write it on the medical questionnaire, including that it is mild now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 左耳、昨日の昼前から時々、今は弱いと書きます。同僚の声を聞き返した場所も、機械のある作業場と添えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 左耳の時期現在と聞返し時の作業環境を記入する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will write: left ear, intermittently since before noon yesterday, mild now. I will also add that the place where I asked my colleague to repeat was a work area with machinery.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Enter the left-ear timing and current state and the work environment when you asked for repetition. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その経過を引き継ぎます。それでは、お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will pass on that history. Please take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 現金を拾われたのですね。お話を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You found some cash, correct? Please tell me about it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 道端で千円札を二枚拾いました。混ぜないよう封筒へ入れ、場所を自分で紙に書いて持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二千円拾得と私物封筒メモで持参を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I found two one-thousand-yen notes beside the road. I put them in an envelope so they would not get mixed with other money, wrote the location on paper myself, and brought them here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report finding two thousand yen and bringing it in your own envelope with your own note. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 封筒とメモは、拾った時にあった物ではありませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: The envelope and note were not there when you found the money, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、二枚の札だけです。封筒は私の物で、メモは家へ戻る前に書きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 拾得札だけと追加紙の作成時を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Correct, only the two notes. The envelope is mine, and I wrote the note before going back home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State that only the banknotes were found and when you created the added note. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 拾った場所を、メモを見ながら教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell me where you found it while looking at your note.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: バス停の屋根の下、柱の右側です。車道へ落ちていたのではなく、歩道で二枚が重なっていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 柱右歩道の直接目撃位置を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Under the bus-stop roof, to the right of the pillar. The two notes were lying one on top of the other on the sidewalk, not in the roadway.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the directly observed location on the sidewalk to the right of the pillar. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 拾った際、近くにいた方へ何か確認しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: When you found it, did you check anything with people nearby?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 停留所にいた一人へ尋ねましたが、自分の物ではないと言われました。その方へ札を預けたりはしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 近くの人へ照会し未引渡しを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I asked one person at the stop, but they said it was not theirs. I did not leave the notes with that person.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you asked someone nearby and did not hand over the money. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お預かりする金額は二千円として確認します。封筒はお返ししますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will confirm the amount we are receiving as two thousand yen. Would you like the envelope returned?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 封筒は返してください。場所のメモは説明用に見せますが、落とした人が書いた紙として扱わないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 封筒返却と本人説明メモの扱いを求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please return the envelope. I will show the location note to explain, but please do not treat it as paper written by the person who lost the money.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for the envelope back and proper handling of your own explanatory note. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 拾得した物と追加した物を分けて確認します。それでは、届出の説明をいたします。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will check the found items separately from the added items. Then I will explain the report procedure. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: このはがきをお使いになりたいのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to use this postcard, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 正月に余った未使用のはがきです。今は暑中の便りを書きたいので、季節の言葉が印刷されたままでもよいか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未使用年賀はがきを夏便りへ使えるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is an unused postcard left over from New Year. I would now like to write a summer greeting, so I would like to ask whether I can use it with the seasonal wording still printed on it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether an unused New Year postcard can be used for a summer greeting. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 料金や使用できる条件は、このはがきの種類を確認します。文面はこれからお書きですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check this type of postcard for postage and usage conditions. Have you yet to write the message?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。絵柄は残したいですが、「あけまして」の文字は今回の便りに合いません。本文は自分で整えてから送りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 残したい絵柄と季節文言修正を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I would like to keep the design, but the words 'Happy New Year' do not suit this message. I would like to put the text in order myself before sending it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the design you wish to retain and correcting the seasonal wording. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 文面をご自身で直すことと、郵便の料金表示を消すことは別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Revising the message yourself is separate from erasing the postcard's postage marking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 料金を表す部分を削ったりはしません。季節の挨拶だけを書き直す方法を考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 料金表示を消さず挨拶文だけ整える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not scrape off the part indicating postage. I will consider a way to rewrite only the seasonal greeting.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Keep the postage marking and revise only the greeting. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はがきの扱いが確認できましたら、文面を準備してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Once we have confirmed how the postcard can be used, please prepare your message.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。余っているからと急いで今日全部出す必要はありません。使える条件を聞いて、一枚ずつ夏の便りを書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 条件確認後に急がず夏便りを一枚ずつ書く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. Just because they are left over, I do not have to rush to send all of them today. I will ask the usage conditions and write summer greetings one card at a time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: After checking the conditions, write summer greetings one card at a time without rushing. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 宛先の方は、転居された可能性などもありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Is it possible that the recipients have moved?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 去年の住所一覧を使う前に、友人へ今の住所を聞きます。年賀状の残りを使っても、文面と住所は今年の内容にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 前年住所一覧をそのまま使わず現住所照会する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Before using last year's address list, I will ask my friends for their current addresses. Even though I use leftover New Year cards, I will make the messages and addresses current for this year.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for current addresses rather than using last year's list as it is. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、はがきの種類を確認してご案内します。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we will check the postcard type and advise you. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お引出しの一万円をお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Here is the ten thousand yen you withdrew.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。急いでかばんへ入れると、自分で数えたか忘れます。こちらで一度確認する時間をもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 現金受領時に本人確認の時間を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Thank you. If I hurry to put it in my bag, I forget whether I counted it myself. May I have time to check it here once?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for time to check the cash yourself when receiving it. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: はい。こちらの台で、ご自身でもご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Certainly. Please also check it yourself on this counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 千円札が十枚ですね。二つの束に分け、五枚ずつとして数えてから一つにまとめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 十枚を五枚ずつ数えて合計確認する方法を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: There are ten one-thousand-yen notes. I will divide them into two stacks, count five in each, and then put them together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show how to check the total by counting the ten notes in groups of five. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご自身が確認しやすい方法で結構です。台の上から離れないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Any method that you find easy to check is fine. Please make sure the money stays on the counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 五枚と五枚で、十枚を確認しました。こちらの控えにも一万円と書いてあるか、合わせて見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 札十枚確認後に控えの額も照合したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have checked ten notes, five and five. I would also like to check whether this transaction slip says ten thousand yen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: After checking ten notes, say you also want to compare the amount on the slip. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 合計額の確認は、お済みでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you finished checking the total amount?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、一万円で、控えの金額とも合っています。これで安心して受け取れます。自分で数える時間をもらえて助かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一万円と控え一致を確認して受領する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, it is ten thousand yen and matches the amount on the slip. Now I can accept it with confidence. Having time to count it myself was helpful.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm ten thousand yen matches the slip and accept it. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お取引の控えもお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will also give you the transaction slip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 控えを受け取りました。現金は一つの封筒にまとめて持ち、帰ってから家計の用途別に分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 控え受領と帰宅後用途分けを述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have received the slip. I will keep the cash together in one envelope and divide it by household spending purposes after getting home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: State that you received the slip and will divide the money by purpose after returning home. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご確認ありがとうございました。それでは、お忘れ物のないようお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for checking. Please make sure you leave nothing behind on your way out.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お探しの商品は、本日は品切れです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: The product you are looking for is out of stock today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 母から、このヨーグルトを頼まれました。別の物を買う前に、近い候補を知らせたいです。棚の写真を撮って送ってもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 頼まれ品欠品で代替棚の写真許可を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: My mother asked me to buy this yogurt. Before buying something else, I would like to tell her about similar options. May I photograph the shelf and send it to her?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask permission to photograph alternative products on the shelf because the requested item is out of stock. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 商品棚だけでしたら、こちらで撮れます。ほかのお客様が入らないようにお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: If it is only the product shelf, you can photograph it here. Please make sure no other customers are included.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 人が通ったので少し待ちます。母には候補の容器と表示を見せ、まだ買っていないと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 他客を避け候補未購入を母へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Someone is passing, so I will wait a little. I will show my mother the containers and labels of the options and tell her I have not bought anything yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Avoid other customers and tell your mother the alternatives have not been purchased. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この小さい容器は、容量がご指定の物より少ない商品です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: This small container holds less than the product you specified.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 少ない方を二つ買えば同じだと決めず、母に必要な量も聞きます。食べるのは母なので、自分の好みで決めたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 小容量二個を独断同等とせず必要量を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Rather than deciding that buying two smaller ones would be the same, I will also ask my mother how much she needs. She is the one who will eat it, so I do not want to decide based on my own preferences.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not decide alone that two small containers are equivalent; ask the amount needed. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お返事があるまで、お待ちになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Will you wait until you receive a reply?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、通路の端で待ちます。返事がなければ別の物を勝手に買わず、今日は欠品だったと伝えるだけにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 返答なしなら無断代替せず欠品報告と決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, I will wait at the edge of the aisle. If there is no reply, I will not buy something else without permission; I will only tell her it was out of stock today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to report the stock shortage without making an unauthorized substitution if there is no reply. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お返事は届きましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 母は今日は買わなくてよいと言っています。候補はかごに入れていないので、そのまま別の買物を続けます。ご案内ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 母の購入不要返答を受け他買物へ進む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: My mother says I do not need to buy any today. I have not put the options in my basket, so I will simply continue with my other shopping. Thank you for your guidance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: After your mother replies that no purchase is needed, move on to other shopping. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、引き続きお買物をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please continue to enjoy your shopping.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 読み聞かせ会へお越しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here for the read-aloud session?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。子どもがこの表紙の本を家で何度も読んでいます。お話を知っていても、今日の会へ参加できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 既読本でも公園読み聞かせ参加可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My child has read the book with this cover many times at home. Can we join today's session even if my child knows the story?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can join the park read-aloud session even with a book already read. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: もちろんです。今日はこちらの本を、皆さんと初めから読みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Of course. Today we will read this book together with everyone from the beginning.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 子どもは自分が知っている場面を早く言いたくなるようです。皆さんが聞く時間には、私の隣で一緒に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 先の場面を話したい子と親隣で聞くと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: My child seems eager to talk about familiar scenes in advance. While everyone is listening, my child will sit beside me and listen together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Decide to listen beside the parent with a child who wants to talk about later scenes. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 読み終えた後、好きだった場面を話す時間があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: After reading, there will be time to talk about favorite scenes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: その時間があれば嬉しいです。子どもには好きな場面を一つ選んで、最後に話せると伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 終了後に本人お気に入り一つを選ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I am glad there is time for that. I will tell my child to choose one favorite scene and that they can talk about it at the end.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Tell your child to choose one personal favorite scene to share after the session. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 前の敷物に親子でお座りいただけます。表紙は見えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Parent and child can sit on the mat at the front. Can you see the cover?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 見えます。家では文字を追っていましたが、今日は係の方が読む声も一緒に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 表紙可視を確認し読声を一緒に聞く希望を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. At home we followed the written words, but today I would also like us to listen together to the staff member reading aloud.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the cover is visible and express a wish to listen to the reader together. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お話が終わりました。お気に入りの場面を、順に伺いましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: The story has finished. Let us hear about your favorite scenes in order.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 子どもは、最後に友達と会えた場面が好きだったと話しました。家でも知っている場面でしたが、今日は係の方の声で聞く楽しみがありました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 終了後に子が選んだ最後の場面と読声の楽しみを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: My child said the favorite scene was meeting a friend at the end. It was a scene we knew from home too, but today there was the pleasure of hearing it in the staff member's voice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: After the story, mention the final scene your child chose and the enjoyment of the reader's voice. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その場面をよく聞いていらっしゃいましたね。ご参加ありがとうございました。それでは、さようなら。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26211-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: You listened to that scene carefully. Thank you for participating. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お買い求めの切符を、ご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please check the ticket you purchased.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 日時が分かったので友人へ写真を送りたいです。友人と合流しますが、友人の分の切符はまだ買っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本人券写真で友人へ予定通知したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Now that I know the date and time, I would like to send my friend a photo. I will meet my friend, but I have not bought their ticket yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to inform your friend of the plan with a photo of your own ticket. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご自身の切符の写真を、予定を知らせるために送るのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: You are sending a photo of your own ticket to let your friend know your plans, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。私の出発時刻を知らせたいだけです。二人分を買ったと友人に思われないよう、私の分だけと書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二人分購入ではなく本人分と明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I only want to tell them my departure time. I will write that it is only mine so my friend does not think I bought tickets for both of us.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specify that you bought only your own ticket, not tickets for two. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この実物は乗車時にお持ちください。写真を送っただけで、切符を友人へ渡したことにはなりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please carry this physical ticket when boarding. Sending a photo alone does not mean you have handed the ticket to your friend.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 実物は自分が持ちます。写真は個人情報が不要な所を写さず、日時と行き先の部分だけ送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 写真通知と実物保持を分け不要情報を避ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will keep the actual ticket myself. For the photo, I will leave out unnecessary personal information and send only the part showing the date, time, and destination.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish photo notification from retaining the physical ticket, avoiding unnecessary information. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お友達は、行き先をご存じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Does your friend know the destination?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 知っています。ただ、合流先は到着する駅です。私の出発駅へ来るお願いではないと、文も添えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 出発駅でなく到着駅での合流を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. However, we are meeting at the arrival station. I will also add a message saying I am not asking them to come to my departure station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you are meeting at the arrival station, not the departure station. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 乗車券と案内の控えは、分けて持っていただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can keep the travel ticket and the information slip separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 乗車券は財布へ、案内の控えは手帳へ入れました。友人にも、自分の切符を別に用意して到着駅で会うと確認しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 券控えを別保存し友人各自券と合流を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I put the ticket in my wallet and the information slip in my planner. I have also confirmed with my friend that they will prepare their own ticket separately and we will meet at the arrival station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Store the ticket and information slip separately and confirm separate tickets and meeting arrangements with your friend. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、切符をお忘れなく。よいお出掛けを。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26212-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please do not forget your ticket. Have a pleasant outing.
